issue_records.title: ERROR: failed to format input: Runic.AssertionError: is_leaf(space_node) && kind(space_node) === K"Whitespace"
issue_records.body_excerpt:
This is with Julia 1.11.1 and Runic 1.0.0: I tried to format the files in [GAP.jl](http://github.com/oscar-system/GAP.jl/) and got this:
```
runic src/constructors.jl
ERROR: failed to format input: Runic.AssertionError: is_leaf(space_node) && kind(space_node) === K"Whitespace". This is unexpected, please file an issue with a reproducible example at https://github.com/fredrikekre/Runic.jl/issues/new.
Stacktrace:
 [1] indent_function_or_macro(ctx::Runic.Context, node::Runic.Node)
   @ Runic ~/.julia/packages/Runic/Ll7qO/src/runestone.jl:1752
 [2] insert_delete_mark_newlines(ctx::Runic.Context, node::Runic.Node)
   @ Runic ~/.julia/packages/Runic/Ll7qO/src/runestone.jl:3108
 [3] format_node!(ctx::Runic.Context, node::Runic.Node)
   @ Runic ~/.julia/packages/Runic/Ll7qO/src/Runic.jl:435
 [4] format_node_with_kids!(ctx::Runic.Context, node::Runic.Node)
   @ Runic ~/.julia/packages/Runic/Ll7qO/src/Runic.jl:354
 [5] format_node!(ctx::Runic.Context, node::Runic.Node)
   @ Runic ~/.julia/packages/Runic/Ll7qO/src/Runic.jl:465
```


I've narrowed it down to this code, however reading that into Julia will kill Julia:
```
function(::Type{T})(::Int) where T
end
```
So here is a less deadly version that also exhibits the issue:
```
function(::Type{T})(::Int) where T<:StepRange
end
```
Actually `creduce` also produced this, which to my surprise is valid Julia code but I don't understand why.
```
function()() end
```

issue_records.title: Fix bad assertion in function signatures
issue_records.body_excerpt:
This patch removes an assertion about whitespace after the `function`
keyword in the indent pass. The core issue is the
`is_longform_anon_function` predicate which is wrong for the testcases,
but the assert is not needed since we can just use the next
non-whitespace noce as the signature in all cases. Fixes #109.

traceability_evidence.commit_message:
Fix bad assertion in function signatures (#110)

This patch removes an assertion about whitespace after the `function`
keyword in the indent pass. The core issue is the
`is_longform_anon_function` predicate which is wrong for the testcases,
but the assert is not needed since we can just use the next
non-whitespace noce as the signature in all cases. Fixes #109.
